name: handella
description: A local-first engineering orchestrator that turns incoming work into supervised Codex jobs.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @handella/contracts && npm run build --workspace @handella/dashboard && npm run build --workspace @handella/service
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @handella/contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names service,dashboard --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @handella/service" "npm run dev --workspace @handella/dashboard"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @handella/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @handella/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
